name: mystic_forge_casts_a_colorless_artifact_from_the_top_paying_its_cost
notes: Printed: 'You may cast artifact spells and colorless spells from the top of your library.' Vial of Dragonfire ({2}, a colorless artifact) on top is cast from the library with the two mana of the pool: it resolves onto the battlefield and the pool is empty (the cost is paid, nothing is free).
